brief:
A surgeon detained during the war in Gaza has returned to the operating room at the Arab Baptist Hospital in Gaza City, according to Palestine News Network. The physician resumed surgical duties amid the hospital's ventilators and resuscitation equipment, continuing to treat patients with war-related injuries sustained across the territory.

The surgeon's return to active practice marks a resumption of medical work interrupted by a period of detention. The hospital corridors carry the mingled scents of disinfectant and blood—conditions reflecting the intense medical demands Gaza's healthcare system faces. Operating rooms remain under severe strain as medical staff contend with multiple obstacles while treating an overwhelming caseload of conflict injuries.

title: Gaza surgeon resumes surgery after detention during war
